rawContent: @MrBananaBeanz @mf_nunya @NBCNews Who is my group? The #Metoo movement has been around a long time. Many allegations, many accused, some never paid the price. No one came up with a sure fire way to say these rules apply to everyone. Despite his allegations he became president, and now they want Biden crucified.

@MrBananaBeanz @mf_nunya @NBCNews My thing is you came at me as if I was playing politics. I looked at the #Metoo movement as a woman. It has nothing to do with politics. But as some started going on this Biden rant now, then my point is once you feel that should affect the candidate then it should for everyone.
